brouillons.titre: Trying to find schooling option with English Language
brouillons.reponse: The biggest mistake I see expats make with Tokyo housing is signing up for an expensive monthly mansion for 6 months 'to take their time looking.' You can realistically find and sign a regular apartment in 1-2 weeks if you prepare your documents in advance (income proof, employment certificate, residence card). The secondhand market on Mercari + Facebook Marketplace makes furnishing for under 50k JPY very feasible.
